defs.meaning: 校订，[印刷]修正；复习（revision 的复数形式）

examples.en: He made some minor revisions to the report before printing it out.
examples.zh: 在将报告打印出来之前，他作了一些小小的修改。

examples.en: I think we have to make some revisions.
I think we will have to make some revisions.

synonyms.meaning: 校订，修正；复习（revision的复数形式）
